pretreatments.description: Knife milling (KM) using a milling chamber with mobile milling elements mounted on a central shaft to disaggregate solid particles and slice fibres.
Hammer milling (HM) consisting of a rotor with hammers that impact material against a breaker plate to grind fibres into long and thin pieces.
Extrusion (EX) where materials are transported by a driving screw along a barrel, subjecting them to friction heat, mixing, vigorous shearing, and pressure release.
Wet shredding using a wet shredder with an integrated heavy material separator to homogenize fluids.

Hydrodynamic cavitation (HC) utilizing a stator and rotor assembly where the rotor speed is controlled by a variable frequency drive to generate microbubbles that collapse to disintegrate lignocellulosic structure.
Sample preparation for chemical analysis (EC and sCOD) involving placing 25 g of substrate in 300 g of distilled water and shaking at 200 rpm for 30 min to produce a filtered leachate.
Wet sieving using a vibration screening machine (FRITSCH Analysette 3 PRO) to analyze particle size distribution.
